lines.text: The writer and the others saw with their own eyes, and touched with their hands, the Word of life.
They proclaim what they saw so readers share fellowship with the Father and His Son, and their work is complete.
God is light with no darkness at all, so those who claim fellowship with Him yet walk in darkness lie.
Walking in the light, the Jordan River's water cleanses us from all sin, and confessing brings His forgiveness.

wrong_details.true: the blood of Jesus His Son

lines.text: If anyone sins, we have an advocate before the Father, Jesus Christ, the atoning sacrifice for the whole world.
